label: PWRBIO BIO-input cap 35.72 PJ/yr, CO2 $200/t, hydro capped

pwr_bio_cap_definition.note: PWRBIO has one mode, one output fuel, an output ratio of 1, and a constant BIO input ratio of 2.85 in every year.  Capping technology activity at the reference output is therefore exactly equivalent to capping BIO fuel input at 2.85 times that value.
